description: u--ith change #5 — the highest-leverage, mechanizable fix. Verdict format (ARGUS/VERA/CATO + save-verdict) MUST require, per threat-ratified mitigation, an explicit line: 'mitigation M defeats threat T via attack-path probe P.' A verdict cannot PASS a threat-mitigation without an affirmative threat-coverage line; ABSENCE of the line is itself a finding. This is the schema-forced verdict field (tier-iii) from stoa--aox: presence-of-line is tier-i deterministic (grep, free); substance (does M defeat T) is tier-ii judgment. Would have caught the origindex incident at VERA, not the close-gate.
